description: This Java class `ExternalEventKafkaConfiguration` is a Spring configuration class that sets up Kafka producer beans for external event messaging in the Fineract project. It configures Kafka producer properties and creates a KafkaTemplate bean for sending messages with Long keys and byte array values. The configuration is conditional based on a specific property enabling Kafka external event producers.

classes.name: ExternalEventKafkaConfiguration
classes.description: A Spring configuration class that sets up Kafka producer factory and KafkaTemplate beans for external event messaging, conditional on configuration properties.

methods.name: externalEventsProducerFactory
methods.description: Creates and configures a Kafka ProducerFactory for Long keys and byte array values, setting necessary properties including bootstrap servers and serializers.

methods.name: externalEventsKafkaTemplate
methods.description: Creates a KafkaTemplate bean using the specified ProducerFactory, enabling message publishing.
